outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker Deep Red, Merge); there is no plot of averaged data.
The two bar graphs (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars and no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image with no averaged/quantified plot.
The bar graphs for SDH and COX signal intensity show only group means with error bars and sample sizes noted in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.

Panel E shows FACS histogram plots (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) representing full distributions of individual cell measurements, not summary bar/mean plots, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
